title: Play pass 4 — answer the Phase 2 exit question
description:
The Phase 2 exit question is: is spending a hero's life a decision you actually feel? Unanswered after three play passes. This is not a code ticket — it is someone sitting down and playing the built game.

docs/TASKS.md has been saying this is the real next move for three sessions. The user's own sequencing was models first, then play; the models (P2b-09/P2b-10) have landed.

What a pass must cover, because no pass has ever met them: training, traits, buildings, gear recovery, and everything the fe1a74b arena/hub batch added. The 22 PROVISIONAL arena feel values have been played once as a whole (verdict: 'feels good for what it is') but never felt individually.

If the answer is no, the fix is design, not code.

Reference: docs/TASKS.md 'Phase 2 exit question' section, and the superseded handoff comment above it.

title: Split D-01 (the walkable town) into shippable slices
description:
D-01a ruled the hard question on 2026-08-13 and is DONE: the town IS hub.tscn with a player-controlled body in it, not a second scene. hub.tscn is already a Node3D with the buildings in it and the panels on a CanvasLayer in the same tree — both candidate routing answers considered before the ruling were wrong for that reason. The avatar is a swappable roster hero, and an embodied hero cannot be sent on an expedition.

So D-01 is writable now. What it needs is a tech-lead split into three tickets, not one: walk + camera, proximity-gated panels, and building visuals. Building levels (P2-07b) already persist and nothing renders them.

Unscheduled on purpose — the core loop comes first and the Phase 2 exit question still governs. This bead is the split, not the build.

Reference: docs/TASKS.md 'Direction backlog', row D-01; GAME_SPEC.md 'The town avatar'; ARCHITECTURE.md 'The town is hub.tscn'; DECISIONS.md.

title: Re-ask the parry window against a real wind-up pose
description:
User's own played feedback: the parry 'needs to be a smidge larger'. arena_parry_active_window = 0.18 s.

Deliberately NOT bumped blind. The 0.18 s was set against the 0.2 s telegraph flash with arithmetic on the page; now that P2b-09/P2b-10 put real animated models in the arena, a real wind-up pose changes the read and the number may not need to move at all. Bumping it on a guess spends the arena's only played value.

game-designer owns this. Needs a played pass first.

Reference: docs/TASKS.md handoff comment, 'The parry-window re-ask'.

title: Re-ask arena hit-stop and the feel values around it
description:
arena_light_attack_hit_stop = 0.04 s and neighbours. The 2026-08-10 playtest line 'still needs tuning for combat weight and feedback' was recorded rather than acted on, because at the time the hit was not visible — retuning weight against a missing signal is tuning against nothing.

That has changed twice since: P2b-03 made the hit visible, and P2b-07 shakes the camera off this same number. So the re-ask now has two consumers rather than an answer.

game-designer owns this. Needs a played pass first.

Reference: docs/TASKS.md handoff comment, 'The arena weight re-ask'.

title: P2b-14 — 8-way locomotion blends from two clips instead of eight
description:
Full ticket body: docs/TASKS.md, '## P2b-14' (~line 1820). Read it there — objective, acceptance criteria, files allowed, non-goals.

Two corrections the body does not carry:
1. It says neither pack ships a strafe clip. Stale — the Mixamo pack has strafe left/right. The missing clip is the backpedal alone.
2. Adopting AnimationTree is a boundary move, not a local change: it is all-or-nothing per skeleton, so it replaces how EVERY animation on that character plays, including the attack/parry/dodge states P2b-11/P2b-12 wired through the raw AnimationPlayer. Route the tree-vs-no-tree call through godot-architect first; it may want a DECISIONS.md entry.

Crosses boundary 2 (combat/arena/arena.tscn) so a verifier pass is mandatory.

title: Source a backpedal walk clip for the roster movement set
description:
Asset blocker, not a code ticket. Neither shipped animation pack has a backward-walk clip. The Mixamo pack DID add strafe left/right — P2b-14's ticket body is stale on this point, it claims no strafe clip exists, which stopped being true when that pack landed. The blocker is the backpedal alone.

Needs a CC0-or-equivalent backpedal walk that starts on the same foot as the forward walk, or the diagonals cross legs when blended. Provenance goes in CREDITS.md like the existing packs.

Do not author it inside the P2b-14 implementation — that is a game-designer/art call.

title: D-04 — caravans
description:
Direction, not a ticket. Escort a cargo wagon to another town to trade resources. Send heroes and let NPCs handle it, or ride along with a controlled hero and defend it.

The user's framing is that this is a SIMULATED EVENT, not background arithmetic — so a version that resolves as a dice roll is not a smaller D-04, it is a different feature. Do not ship that as a first slice.

Needs a second town (D-01 shape), a resource-trading rule, and D-02's played-run machinery for the ride-along half.

Reference: docs/TASKS.md 'Direction backlog', row D-04.

title: Arena resolve() ignores its parameters and loot_seed stays 0
description:
Live debt from P2b-01e, unchanged. combat/arena/arena.gd's resolve(team, wave) ignores both declared parameters behind release-stripped asserts, and CombatResult.loot_seed stays 0 on the arena path.

Both are inert while the arena result is display-only, which the 2026-08-11 decision makes a lasting state rather than a Phase 3 countdown. They go live in D-02 and not before. Do not 'fix' this early — the arena is a combat-feel prototype by decision.

title: D-02 — controlled expeditions (played runs, not resolved ones)
description:
Direction, not a ticket. The largest of the four by a wide margin. Walk out of the town gate into an instanced map with objectives and play the run. Sent expeditions stay math and are not replaced.

Cannot become a ticket until these are answered: what an objective is, how a run ends, whether the instance is authored or generated (GAME_SPEC.md 'Scope boundaries' deliberately excludes procedural generation from the draft), and how a played run reports through CombatResult without anything upstream branching on which path produced it.

This is also where player-controlled combat gets permadeath. Arena permadeath is deliberately unwired and is NOT a gap — that was decided 2026-08-11 (DECISIONS.md, GAME_SPEC.md 'Combat model'). Do not file a ticket to wire it.

Reference: docs/TASKS.md 'Direction backlog', row D-02.

title: D-03 — hop into a sent expedition mid-run
description:
Direction, not a ticket. Take direct control of one hero mid-run to raise its chance of success.

The hard question is what the math path does with the intervention: an expedition currently resolves every wave inside one synchronous Expedition.resolve() call, so 'mid-run' is not a moment that exists yet.

Reference: docs/TASKS.md 'Direction backlog', row D-03.

title: Move P2-25/P2-26/P2-27 bodies to TASKS-DONE.md
description:
All three are DONE with their full bodies still inline in docs/TASKS.md (~lines 914-1260) rather than moved to docs/TASKS-DONE.md like the other 78. Pure carrying cost in a file that is read start-to-finish.

Keep their Findings reachable — P2-27's records that it shipped select_mode = 2 labelled SELECT_MULTI when 2 is actually SELECT_TOGGLE, and both gates plus 148 tests stayed green because no test in this suite drives a real mouse click through any list.

title: P2b-02 — controller input (ON HOLD by the user)
description:
ON HOLD. Do not schedule it, do not route its design questions, do not let a related ticket quietly pick it up.

GAME_SPEC.md:84 still calls controller support a hard constraint. That contradiction is deliberate and the reasoning is on the original row in docs/TASKS.md.

This bead exists so the hold is visible rather than rediscovered. Only the user lifts it.
